Frequently asked questions

Which restaurants accept EBT in Glendale?

Glendale has 63 restaurants authorized for the SNAP Restaurant Meals Program, including Subway, Burger King, Jack in the Box, McDonald's. Each accepts EBT from eligible recipients for prepared meals.

Can anyone use EBT at these Glendale restaurants?

No — only recipients enrolled in the Restaurant Meals Program: those who are 60 or older, have a disability, or are experiencing homelessness (and their spouses). Arizona is a participating state.

What can I buy with EBT at a restaurant in Glendale?

Hot and ready-to-eat meals. Alcohol, tobacco and non-food items aren't covered, and most states don't allow EBT to pay tips. It draws from your regular SNAP balance.
